''Господарите на Родопите'' (The Lords of the [[Rhodope Mountains|Rhodopes]]){{cite web | url = https://sportal.bg/news-2020061110513760149 | title = Феновете в Кърджали: Ние сме Арда - господари на Родопите | language=bg | date = 30 October 2017 | access-date = 31 March 2024}} | founded = {{Start date and age|1924|08|10}} (as ''Rodopski Sokol'') | ground = [[Arena Arda]], [[Kardzhali]] | capacity = 11,114 | chairman = Yashar Durmushev | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Aleksandar Tunchev]] | league = [[First Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|First League]]| | season = [[2025–26 First Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|2025–26]]| | position = First League, 6th of 16| | website = {{URL|http://fcarda.bg/}} | pattern_la1 = _arda-26-27-h-n | pattern_b1 = _arda-26-27-h-n | pattern_ra1 = _arda-26-27-h-n | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = _arda-25-26-h | leftarm1 = 93CFF0 | body1 = 93CFF0 | rightarm1 = 93CFF0 | shorts1 = FFFFFF | socks1 = B0E0FF| | pattern_la2 = _arda-26-27-a | pattern_b2 = _arda-26-27-a-n | pattern_ra2 = _arda-26-27-a | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000060 | socks2 = 000060| | pattern_la3 = _uhlsportstram19wbr | pattern_b3 = _uhlsportstram19wbr | pattern_ra3 = _uhlsportstram19wbr | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = FFFFFF | body3 = FFFFFF | rightarm3 = FFFFFF | shorts3 = FFFFFF | socks3 = FFFFFF | current = }} '''FC Arda 1924 Kardzhali''' ({{langx|bg|ПФК Арда Кърджали}}) is a Bulgarian professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Kardzhali]] that competes in [[First Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|First League]], the top tier of the Bulgarian football league system. It was founded on 13 October 1924, as an association football branch of a larger sports society in the town. The club was reestablished in 2015, after its former entity was dissolved. Named after the [[Arda (Maritsa)|Arda river]], a tributary of the [[Maritsa]], Arda's home ground is the [[Arena Arda]] in Kardzhali, which has a capacity of 15,000 spectators. For the majority of its existence, the club regularly participated in the [[Bulgarian B PFG|Second League]], with its highest-ever ranking a second-place finish during the 1955–56 Bulgarian Second League. In the [[Bulgarian Cup]], Arda have reached the finals once, in 2021, losing to [[PFC CSKA Sofia|CSKA Sofia]]. [[File:PFC Arda by BISO 2021.jpg|300px|thumb|right|Arda Kardzhali line-up in 2021]] In 2018–19, Arda won the Second League promotion play-off against [[PFC Septemvri Sofia|Septemvri Sofia]], resulting in the club's first-ever appearance in the Bulgarian top division."}}
